title: Tangkak Merdeka Half Marathon 2026 Review: Johor's Independence-Day 21K
seo_title: Tangkak Merdeka Half Marathon 2026 Review | Johor Malaysia
meta_description: Tangkak Merdeka Half Marathon 2026: August 16 at Dataran Tangkak, Johor. A Merdeka-season half marathon in Johor's textile town.
dek: Set for 16 August 2026 at Dataran Tangkak in Johor, this Merdeka-season half marathon celebrates Malaysia's Independence Day in the country's textile capital.
verdict: The Tangkak Merdeka Half Marathon is a Johor community race timed for Malaysia's Merdeka (Independence Day) season, held at Dataran Tangkak — the town square of Johor's textile-production hub, known as Malaysia's 'Fabric Town.' The Merdeka theme gives the race patriotic character. Tangkak sits near the Johor-Melaka border, roughly 2.5 hours from both KL and Singapore. A community-flavoured Johor half marathon with Merdeka-season atmosphere.
